# Ragdoll capture timing ownership

At `ab1f7568a`, the viewer installs presentation physics in `FixedPostUpdate`.
Ragdoll muscles and damping run in `FixedUpdate` using the generic Bevy time,
and terrain contact correction runs in `Update`. Pausing Avian's physics
clock alone does not pause those other owners. The local pause candidate was
removed after this mismatch was identified; its repeated-view pass does not
prove the sampled ragdoll simulation was faithful.

The installed Bevy `TimeUpdateStrategy::FixedTimesteps(n)` advances time by
exactly `n` fixed intervals per app update. The fixed scheduler consumes
virtual-time overstep; this offers a possible capture-owned clock that freezes
all fixed-update owners between views and advances one interval per later
logical sample. Its interaction with screenshot callbacks, initial ragdoll
settling, terrain correction, scene transitions and previously configured
clock ownership remains unverified. Do not change an acceptance threshold or
claim it is a complete solution from source inspection alone.
